sources.title: North Dakota Secretary of State, 2024 Official General Election Results, Governor and Lt. Governor, county export (Statewide County Results.xlsx)

method: pipeline/patches/2024_ND_GOV.py reads the official county export of the Governor contest and keeps Burleigh and Divide. Armstrong/Strinden (Republican) is rep, Piepkorn/Hart (Democratic-NPL) is dem, and Coachman/Gessele (independent nomination) plus write-ins are oth.
validation: Filled counties equal the official county totals: Burleigh 38015 dem 11,343 / rep 36,496 / oth 3,592 (3,492 Coachman + 100 write-in); Divide 38023 dem 226 / rep 894 / oth 67. With the 51 MIT counties (dem 82,474 / rep 209,666 / oth 17,193), the state total becomes dem 94,043 / rep 247,056 / oth 20,852, exactly the certified statewide totals (0.00% difference).
